versions.name: Bird Study
versions.description: Identify twenty wild birds by sight and five by song, keep a field notebook of habitat and feeding habits, learn how beak and foot shape follow habitat, and build a feeder, nest box, or backyard sanctuary.

provenance.notes: Introduction year (and BSA number where absent) backfilled from the USSSP merit badge history table; for a renamed badge this is when THIS name took effect, not when the lineage began.
